answer: Work history locks for 90 days before it counts as standing. Each receipt hashes its payload, so a duplicate dies on replay, never on name matching. One upheld challenge revokes the trail back to the last clean epoch. An attacker who plants identities on a fresh knoll needs 90 days of real output per account before any of it pays, while the reef of stale keys stays worthless. A crystal of new addresses does not shortcut the clock.
